walkthroughReviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat), a different agent from the author
author: Codex documentation author
frontend: Working documentation preview at 127.0.0.1:43333 over the immutable configuration backend at 127.0.0.1:43332
browser: Playwright 1.62.1 Chromium from the workspace, headless, one isolated context per identity; scripts written by the reviewer from the article text

steps.action: An operator reads the reference itself in the signed-out formal reader
steps.actual: With no app account and no sign-in, the formal reader opened the reference at /documentation/reference with H1 "Look up terms, permissions, and file behavior", all six sections present and an On this page outline (1). The Deployment operator row of the permissions table reads: "Maintains the installation and service configuration. This is an operational responsibility, not an additional app account role. Use an appropriate account for in-app work.". The operator's own configuration facts, including MAX_UPLOAD_MB, are readable here. App API calls during this anonymous reading: 0.

steps.action: The operator guidance the reference points at is reachable without an app session
steps.actual: From the reference the signed-out reader followed its closing links and reached deployment-configuration: "Configure a deployment"; personal-settings: "Manage your profile and preferences"; organisation-and-users: "Manage your organization and users", with no app account. The reference does not link operator-troubleshooting; the troubleshooting guide is what carries that link, and the discovery record covers it.

steps.action: The account-role enum in source contains no operator role
steps.actual: packages/db/src/schema/auth.ts declares USER_ROLES as ["administrator","legal_team_member","contributor","business_user"] and the users table role column is typed to that enum, so no deployment-operator account role exists to grant. This is a source reading at app commit 6a8873dbda333fd9992eb77525d4bfa3f47af20d, not a browser procedure. The matching browser evidence is the role control recorded in independent-comparison-and-roles.json.

correctionOf: docs/documentation/batches/DOC-024/independent-reference.json: its operator step listed the roles existing users hold and drew a conclusion about permitted roles from them.
limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
The signed-out reader is how an operator with no app account reads these guides in this lab. It is not a claim about any production access policy, which DOC-004 settles.
